# Ripple: a flat ring 2.4 m across (baked at its largest; the game scales it up from small).
# Origin at its centre on the water. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ripple --base-color 0.8667 0.8314 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh torus --name Ripple --major-segments 32 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 1.2 --minor-radius 0.045 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.4
apply --scale
material assign Ripple
shade flat
export ripple.glb
